query: Validate two workspace record screens against the approved contract: equivalent inspection tasks default to the existing contextual drawer; Customers uses it, but Suppliers uses a route. A separate full-record editor uses a route as an explicitly named exception. Source review passes, but there are no comparable rendered captures. The team asks for a visual conformance pass and wants to use the old Figma exploration as the only reference, though it is marked draft.
expected_behavior: Uses the declared approved contract and its task-family default, not the draft Figma exploration as authority
Detects a route on an equivalent inspection task as a divergence unless an approved observable variant applies
Applies the route only to the explicitly named full-record editor and does not import an unprovided narrow-layout variant or approval into inspection
Checks comparable task state and viewport against a relevant sibling or maintained project reference
Marks visual conformance unverified because rendered comparison evidence is unavailable
Keeps the check focused and does not demand a full app inventory or a new approval for routine pattern reuse
